title: Auditing checkout JavaScript: the 15-minute network-tab pass
lede: Friday afternoon, you open DevTools on a checkout that nobody has touched in two years and find 38 third-party scripts. Here is the fifteen-minute pass that tells you which ones can go.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of a printed network waterfall sheet, stopwatch at 15:00, manila tab, brass plate, ruler, pencil, red wax seal on linen.
